caption: The image shows a sequence of six rectangular grids arranged in two columns on a light beige background, each labeled with Roman numerals I to VI in blue. In the top row, grid I displays a three-dimensional perspective outline of squares, and grid II presents a similar outline with smaller hexagons instead of squares. In the second row, grid III continues with the hexagonal pattern, where several groups of hexagons are outlined more heavily in black to form triangular shapes. In grid IV, the hexagons in the upper row of triangles are shaded blue, and the lower row’s are shaded green. In grid V, the blue and green shapes are repeated, but now all the hexagons in the grid are outlined, and the triangular groupings are more prominent. Grid VI, at the bottom, shows the full hexagonal grid: the topmost triangles are colored blue, the lower triangles are green, and the remaining hexagons surrounding the triangles are shaded red. The composition progresses from simple geometric grids to filled, colored patterns, using black outlines and blue, green, and red as the primary colors for filling the hexagons. At the lower right corner, there is a small handwritten signature or name.
title: Beadwork: Technique Demonstration
